newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent slides on technical move, gasoline weak.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent slides on technical move, gasoline weak.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures fell back to the day's low on Monday afternoon on a technical retracement, and gas oil failed to sustain last week's rally, brokers said.

Oct Brent slipped back to $22.50 per barrel by 1456 GMT, four cents lower on the day, having briefly jumped 19 cents soon after a strong NYMEX open. NYMEX gasoline exerted the strongest negative influence on the market, shedding 1.02 cents to 64.25 cents per gallon.
Sept gas oil lost 25 cents to $219.50 per tonne, having rejected upside resistance at $221.75.
The Sept/Oct gas oil spread slipped by $1 to +$8 per tonne, having rallied sharply last week. But the Oct Brent/gas oil crack spread was steady at about $5.70 per barrel.
Brokers said New York gasoline and heating oil jumped on opening, but failed to break through significant resistance levels and were now retracing.
"It's a purely technical move," said one.
